calls.statement:
WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date > DATE '2024-12-22' AND sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'),
d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT w.sales_line_id, w.receipt_id, w.line_no, w.sale_date, w.store_key, w.product_key, w.member_key, w.channel_code, w.quantity, w.net_amount, w.etl_loaded_at
FROM w JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 12

WITH w AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE sale_date > DATE '2024-12-22' AND sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND member_key IS NOT NULL)
SELECT (store_id=999) is999, (category='ZZ Test') iszz, count(*) lines, count(distinct member_key) mk FROM w GROUP BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
      AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT m.tier, count(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS active_members
FROM active a
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE m.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
